v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

Initial release of diagram-gen-tool-free – a lightweight Mermaid chart generation tool (免费版).

- Supports quick creation and editing of Mermaid format flowcharts and sequence diagrams via natural language input.
- Outputs standard Mermaid syntax suitable for direct embedding in Markdown documents.
- Allows reading and editing existing `.mmd` files.
- Designed for technical documentation, project sketches, and personal development.
- No extra software installation required; image export supported via optional `mermaid-cli`.
- Core features: generate flowcharts (with branches, loops, parallel flows), sequence diagrams (participants, messages, annotations), and execute commands using configurable parameters.
